auth.note: Reads work without a key at a lower limit; a key raises it to your plan.

function.name: chord_overview
function.description: What the Chord index holds right now on chain 4663: 24h volume, swap count, tokens traded, and the venues with their share. Use first to orient.

function.name: chord_search_tokens
function.description: Find listed tokens on chain 4663 by symbol, name or address. Returns up to 10 matches with addresses and whether each is a tokenized stock.

function.name: chord_price
function.description: Live price, 24h change, 24h volume and trade count for one token, from Chord's own index of on-chain trades.

token.description: Symbol like NVDA or USDG, or a 0x address

function.name: chord_stocks
function.description: Every tokenized stock and ETF on the chain with price, 24h change, 24h volume, trades, traders, buy share, after-hours share of the last 7 days, and the gap to the issuer's reference price (NAV) where published. Sorted by 24h volume.

function.name: chord_stock
function.description: One tokenized stock in depth: the screener row plus activity windows (5m/1h/6h/24h buys, sells, volume, wallets), all-time high, first trade, and the pools it traded in over the last 24h.

token.description: Symbol like SPY or a 0x address

function.name: chord_quote
function.description: Best route to swap one token for another across every venue on the chain. Amount is human units (e.g. "0.5" ETH). Returns the expected output, price impact, the venues on the route, and the raw quote to pass to chord_swap_tx.

tokenIn.description: Symbol or address to pay with, e.g. ETH, USDG

tokenOut.description: Symbol or address to receive, e.g. NVDA

amount.description: Amount of tokenIn in human units, as a string

slippageBps.description: Slippage tolerance in basis points, default 100 = 1%

function.name: chord_swap_tx
function.description: Turn a quote from chord_quote into an UNSIGNED transaction (to, data, value, gasLimit) for the given wallet. Chord never signs or holds funds: send the result to the agent's wallet to sign and broadcast on chain 4663. An ERC-20 input needs an allowance for the returned `to` first.

wallet.description: The wallet that will sign and receive

function.name: chord_smart_money
function.description: The wallets that traded best on the chain, ranked from the tape with routers and bots removed: profit, volume, trades, win rate, best token.

function.name: chord_wallet_pnl
function.description: One wallet's book on the chain: realized and open profit per token from an average-cost read of its swaps, plus totals. Balances that arrived by transfer have no cost basis and are excluded.

function.name: chord_arc_overview
function.description: What the Chord index holds on Arc (chain 5042, USDC-native) right now: 24h volume in USDC, swap count, tokens traded, venues with their share, and how far back the records go. Arc is indexed by Chord itself from every Uniswap pool and launchpad on the chain.

function.name: chord_arc_tokens
function.description: Tokens traded on Arc in the last 24h with price, 24h change, volume, buy/sell split, trades and attributed traders. Most Arc tokens are unlisted (no logo yet) but carry their on-chain symbol and name; `listed` says which have curated metadata.

function.name: chord_arc_token
function.description: One Arc token in depth: identity (on-chain symbol/name/decimals), 24h figures, an hourly volume/price series for the requested window, venue split, and every indexed pool holding it (V3/V2 pool addresses or V4 poolIds with hooks).

function.name: chord_arc_venues
function.description: Per-venue daily volume on Arc for the last N days (1..180) with each venue's share of the window — Uniswap V3, V2, V4 and the launchpad forks as separate rows.

function.name: chord_lp_pools
function.description: Pools ranked for a liquidity provider on Arc (or Robinhood Chain 4663 / Monad 143): TVL, volume by window, fees earned by LPs, fee/TVL and its annualised APR, 24h LP adds/removes, providers, whether a V4 hook can gate adds. Suspect pools (wash turnover, dust TVL) are flagged and hidden unless asked. Use for 'where to LP', 'best fee APR', 'is pool X worth providing to'.

quote.description: restrict to pools quoted in this token (symbol or address)

function.name: chord_lp_positions
function.description: A wallet's liquidity positions (Uniswap V3/V4 position NFTs) from Chord's LP ledger: pool, venue, fee tier, range, in range now and distance to the edge, dollars in/out, value now, fees earned and uncollected, PnL, age, JIT flag; plus a summary (open/closed, win rate, realized PnL, fees).

function.name: chord_lp_leaderboard
function.description: Top liquidity providers from the position ledger (LP Agent style): profit 7d/30d/all, win rate, fees, positions, pools, average age and invested size, what they provide to. JIT and same-operator clusters are excluded; filters mirror LP Agent's panel.

function.name: chord_ask
function.description: Ask Chord's analyst about Arc (chain 5042) in plain language and get a researched answer: trending, a token's flow/holders/risk, support and resistance with an entry ladder, top traders on a token, a wallet's PnL and trades, largest prints, launches, depth, a bridge quote, position sizing, or an ad-hoc SQL question over the index. Returns the answer text, source links, an optional route card and any tables the analysis produced. Needs a Chord API key (CHORD_API_KEY). Slower than the data tools (5–40 s); use it for judgement, use the other tools for raw numbers.

wallet.description: The agent's own wallet, so 'my PnL' resolves
